rows.label: bf03030100_0010
rows.name: What's that, mo?

rows.label: bf03030100_0020
rows.name: A Cloud Sea compass.

rows.label: bf03030100_0030
rows.name:
A must-have for salvagers. It's
sort of a map of the Cloud Sea.

rows.label: bf03030100_0040
rows.name: If you do this... And this...

rows.label: bf03030100_0050
rows.name: What's the date today?

rows.label: bf03030100_0060
rows.name:
Um... It's September 5th,
4058 in the Divine Calendar.

rows.label: bf03030100_0070
rows.name:
Thanks. Once you enter the year,
month, and day...

rows.label: bf03030100_0080
rows.name: See?

rows.label: bf03030100_0090
rows.name: This is really handy, mo!

rows.label: bf03030100_0100
rows.name:
It seems Gula is closest
to the World Tree.

rows.label: bf03030100_0110
rows.name: The problem is getting a ship.

rows.label: bf03030100_0120
rows.name: The army controls every ship in town.

rows.label: bf03030100_0130
rows.name: So that's probably impossible.

rows.label: bf03030100_0140
rows.name: Seems that way.

rows.label: bf03030100_0150
rows.name: You can't ride on me, you know.

rows.label: bf03030100_0160
rows.name: I know. Still, this is a problem...

rows.label: bf03030100_0170
rows.name:
You just need to get on a ship, mo?
Tora knows a good place, mo!

rows.label: bf03030100_0180
rows.name: You do?

rows.label: bf03030100_0190
rows.name:
There's someone building a ship
at Gula's butt, mo.

rows.label: bf03030100_0200
rows.name:
An old guy named Umon who knew
Grandpa Senzou, mo.

rows.label: bf03030100_0210
rows.name:
Maybe he'll lend us one
if we explain what's going on.

rows.label: bf03030100_0220
rows.name:
Sure, it's worth a
shot! Let's get going.
